name: Llama Server
description: Prebuilt llama-server install providing OpenAI-compatible /v1 API. Gracefully degrades if binary unavailable.

VERSION.description: Llama.cpp release ref selecting the asset tarball

CUDA_ARCHS.description: Comma-separated GPU architectures for prebuilt variant selection

ASSET_URL.description: Override default asset URL; empty = derived from VERSION+CUDA_ARCHS

INSTALL_PATH.description: Path where llama-server binary and libs are installed

COMPILE.description: Source-build fallback when no matching prebuilt asset available

BUNDLE_CUDA_LIBS.description: Bundle CUDA 13.3 runtime libs (cudart/cublas/cublasLt) into INSTALL_PATH
